create_warmup_lr_lambda: create a learning rate multiplier that linearly warms up then decays at milestones using warmup_lr_lambda
build_cosine_lr_lambda: build a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler with warmup using the CosineLRLambda class
create_lr_scheduler: create a torch learning rate scheduler from config using the LRScheduler class constructor

get_current_lr: get the current learning rate from the optimizer using the LRScheduler get_lr method
